provenance.steps: Identity, checked on every projected month. Fixture: eight loans in two currencies and five segments, at balances up to about 10^9 and terms up to 359 months: FIXED annuities (one at a zero rate), linear and bullet loans, two RESET loans in their fixed period (reset months 2024-09-30 and 2027-02-28) and a FLOAT loan resetting monthly (2024-02-29). In each trial every projected month gets a CPR from the seeded generator: 0 with probability zero_share, 1 with probability full_share, otherwise uniform on [0, max_cpr] rounded to 6 places; the reset month gets 0 (open question on the reset month). For every loan, every segment and currency total and every month: opening = scheduled + prepaid + repricing + closing, each month opens at the previous closing, and the lifetime principal (scheduled + prepaid + repricing) equals the as-of balance, within 0.005. Hand sums of the as-of balances per segment and currency: MTG_FIX EUR 987,654,321.12 + 123,456,789.01; MTG_RST EUR 456,789,012.34 + 77,777,777.77; one loan each otherwise; MTG_FIX appears in EUR and USD and is never added across currencies. Horizons are hand counts of month ends from 2024-01-31 to maturity or to the next reset. The identity is also checked on the CF-SCHED-01, CF-PREPAY-01 and CF-RESET-01 fixtures and on the SCN-BASE-01 book under shocks of 0 and +/-200bp.
